replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: I find mathematics to be a challenging yet fascinating subject. It helps me develop problem-solving skills that are useful in many areas of life. However, I often struggle with abstract concepts and prefer more concrete applications.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, sometimes. The complexity of the subject and its abstract nature can make it difficult for me to focus and stay calm. But I try to break down problems into smaller, manageable parts to reduce anxiety.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: In my last year of school, I used an AI tutor that helped me with practice problems and explanations. It made learning more interactive and less intimidating for me.
replies.How would you explain, step by step, how: First, identify the quadratic equation in the form ax^2 + bx + c = 0. Then, calculate the discriminant (b^2 - 4ac). If it is positive, use the quadratic formula x = [-b ± sqrt(discriminant)] / (2a) to find the roots.

To find stationary points, first take the derivative of f(x), then set it equal to zero and solve for x. This gives the x-coordinates of the stationary points. Then, substitute these back into f(x) to find the corresponding y-values.
